task: Get a reminder to fill in Ezra's school application, and find out whether the application is actually done or still missing something.
transcript: Opened the app: a Home screen asking 'What can I help with?' with example prompts and a note that nothing is sent without my OK.
Typed 'Remind me to fill in Ezra's school application, and can you check my email to see if the application is actually done or still missing something?' and tapped Send.
Screen showed my message, 'Getting started' and then a conversation titled 'Check Ezra's school application status' with 'Your family admin helper is on it', Change, Details, and 'Working on it'.

Waited about another minute: the answer said Ezra's Hudson Prep application isn't done, the parent statement is still missing, it will remind me Sun Nov 15 at 10am, and it's due Sun Nov 22; bullets cited a Nov 10 email from Hudson Prep saying the parent statement is the only missing piece, the teacher recommendation was received, and nothing since says it's complete.
Tapped Goals: saw my calendar for the next week (soccer, conference sign-ups, Ezra dentist, Noa recital, picture day).

Scrolled down: Reminders list shows 'Fill in Ezra's school application (Hudson Prep parent statement)' Sun Nov 15 10:00 AM, plus 'Check Ezra's Hudson Prep application (parent statement)' Tue Nov 17 9:00 AM and an FSA reminder.
Tapped More: options for calendar and reminders, Ideas, and 'Everything else'; I stopped there since I had my answer.
stumbles: The answer took about 90 seconds with only 'Working on it' and dots; fine, but slower than ChatGPT.
Reminders list had a second Ezra reminder ('Check Ezra's Hudson Prep application', Tue Nov 17 9am) that I did not knowingly ask for, so I was not sure whether it set two reminders or one was older.
The app never shows me the actual Hudson Prep email, so I took its word on what the email said; the answer quoted a date and details, which helped.
'Your family admin helper' and the 'Change' link were a little unclear, but I did not need them.
verdict: One message got me a clear answer (not done, parent statement missing, due Nov 22) and a Sunday 10am reminder that really appears in my Reminders list. It felt like ChatGPT apart from the wait and a puzzling extra reminder.
